svg.title: Three independent private DNS and application paths
svg.desc: Case A resolves the normal Blob hostname from a linked Azure VNet and then connects separately to the private endpoint. Case B forwards external Blob queries to the Azure inbound resolver. Case C forwards a branch namespace from Azure to a different external DNS target. The cases do not form a forwarding loop.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: C — Azure client resolves a branch-owned namespace

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: B — External client resolves an Azure private namespace

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: A — Azure client resolves Blob, then opens a separate HTTPS connection
